portInfo.description: Dominica Air and Sea Ports Authority documents a dedicated Roseau Cruise Ship Berth in the capital, giving an explicit WGS-compatible latitude/longitude, platform dimensions (160 ft / 49 m by 37 ft / 11.30 m), an 88 m access walkway, 13 m depth alongside, five berthing dolphins and six mooring dolphins. DASPA states the berth is within walking distance of Roseau’s business and shopping areas and close to the Tourism Information Centre, Dominica Museum and Craft Center. Inland waterfalls and national-park roads need coaches timed to all-aboard — those minutes are not on the berth page.
portInfo.currency: East Caribbean Dollar (XCD), US Dollar accepted
